target.pageTitle: Field Notes — Practical guides for small teams

summary.verdict: A solid base with a few clear visibility improvements.

topPriorities.title: Search description
topPriorities.whyItMatters: The page is missing a concise search-result summary.
topPriorities.nextStep: Add a specific meta description that explains the page in one useful sentence.

topPriorities.title: Social preview
topPriorities.whyItMatters: Shared links may inherit incomplete or unpredictable preview content.
topPriorities.nextStep: Provide accurate og:title, og:description, and og:image values that match the page.

topPriorities.title: Structured data
topPriorities.whyItMatters: The page has no valid JSON-LD block for machine-readable context.
topPriorities.nextStep: Add the smallest accurate Schema.org JSON-LD type supported by the visible page content.

findings.title: Secure transport
findings.plainEnglish: Visitors and crawlers receive the page over HTTPS.
findings.recommendation: Keep HTTPS redirects and certificate renewal in place.

findings.title: Page title
findings.plainEnglish: The title is present and gives the page a primary label.
findings.recommendation: Keep the title unique and aligned with the page's main intent.

findings.title: Search description
findings.plainEnglish: The page is missing a concise search-result summary.
findings.recommendation: Add a specific meta description that explains the page in one useful sentence.

findings.title: Primary heading
findings.plainEnglish: The page has one clear primary heading.
findings.recommendation: Keep supporting sections under logical H2/H3 headings.

findings.title: Canonical URL
findings.plainEnglish: The page declares which URL should represent this content.
findings.recommendation: Keep the canonical absolute and aligned with the public production URL.

findings.title: Indexing directive
findings.plainEnglish: No page-level noindex directive was found.
findings.recommendation: Confirm production headers do not add a conflicting X-Robots-Tag.

findings.title: Structured data
findings.plainEnglish: The page has no valid JSON-LD block for machine-readable context.
findings.recommendation: Add the smallest accurate Schema.org JSON-LD type supported by the visible page content.

findings.title: Social preview
findings.plainEnglish: Shared links may inherit incomplete or unpredictable preview content.
findings.evidence: Open Graph title: false; description: false; image: false
findings.recommendation: Provide accurate og:title, og:description, and og:image values that match the page.

findings.title: Image text alternatives
findings.plainEnglish: Nearly every image declares alternative text, including empty alt for decorative images.
findings.evidence: Images with an alt attribute: 6 of 6
findings.recommendation: Keep meaningful alt text specific and decorative alt text empty.

findings.title: Mobile viewport
findings.plainEnglish: The page declares a mobile viewport for responsive rendering.
findings.recommendation: Keep responsive layouts tested at 375px and 390px.

findings.title: Page language
findings.plainEnglish: The page declares a language for browsers and assistive technology.
findings.recommendation: Keep the language code aligned with the visible content.

findings.title: Robots file
findings.plainEnglish: A conventional robots.txt file is reachable.
findings.recommendation: Review it before launches so important public pages remain crawlable.

findings.title: XML sitemap
findings.plainEnglish: No reachable sitemap.xml was found at the conventional location.
findings.recommendation: Publish an XML sitemap or reference its real location from robots.txt.

findings.title: AI guidance file
findings.plainEnglish: No llms.txt file was found; this is optional, not a ranking requirement.
findings.recommendation: Consider llms.txt only after canonical pages, metadata, and structured data are accurate.

disclaimer: Automated point-in-time technical audit of one public page and conventional discovery files. It is not a legal, accessibility, security, ranking, or compliance certification.
